verdict.rationale: Evidence implies a network of multiple locations/mail centers (multiple addresses for different markets, transferring between mail centers, select locations offering check deposit, forwarding domestically or internationally), suggesting broad geographic coverage. However, there is no evidence of an actual location-browsing/directory feature that lets a prospective nomad compare per-location capabilities (pricing, scanning, check deposit, international mail handling) before signing up. Missing for 10: a searchable location directory or map, explicit country/state list, and per-location capability comparison shown pre-signup.
